metadata.title: Clicked like a confused potato and somehow dragged 2 clueless souls? Valorant madness!
metadata.description:
Tapped like I was chasing shadows.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure disbelief.
Did NOT deserve those lucky hits but hey, I’ll take the chaos.
If your aim’s mostly happy accidents, join the club.

Smash that like if your aim’s mostly chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
